295:t_026:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$アーバレスト$$! $$宗介$$'s here too!」

295:t_026:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Reunited on Mars... This can hardly be a coincidence.」

295:t_026:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Were they tossed about by a great power, just as we were...?」

295:t_026:7.en:
$$万丈$$
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... And the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...)

295:t_027:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm not asking you to scream and cry, but show some damn shock at least!」

295:t_027:2.en:
$$レド$$
「He's beyond a calm soldier...! Is he... human?!」

295:t_027:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Don't worry. I'm human, just like you.」

295:t_027:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I bleed when I'm cut, and someday I'll die...」

295:t_027:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sorry, but I ain't about to believe that!」

295:t_027:6.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Then try to defeat me. If you can.」

295:t_027:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You don't have to tell me...!」

295:t_029:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Your woman's been beaten, and you don't even bat an eye!」

295:t_029:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I may have told you before, but that isn't our relationship.」

295:t_029:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...But I'm relieved! He's human too!」

295:t_029:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then there must be a way to fight him! Let's do it!」

295:t_100:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've been waiting to see you, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

295:t_100:2.en:
$$メール$$
「Even Darling's $$ヒートスマイル$$ and passionate advances don't faze him!」

295:t_100:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even $$メール$$'s clueless jokes don't faze him!」

295:t_100:9.en:
$$メール$$
「Grr! I'll get some fresher material and challenge you again!」

295:t_100:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's not the point, $$メール$$!」

295:t_101:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$悲しみの乙女$$, $$セツコ・オハラ$$. I'll face you in $$バルビエル$$'s place.」

295:t_101:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Why...? $$バルビエル$$ was fixated on me on $$翠の地球$$, too...)

295:t_101:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Could that be the key to defeating him...?!)

295:t_102:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... I can't let them have you.」

295:t_102:1.en:
$n
「I don't belong to anyone...! I won't let you do whatever you want with me, either!」

295:t_102:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I see... I certainly sense potential in you.」

295:t_102:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It's a shame I must cut you down before it awakens.」

295:t_103:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You seem shaken, $$沈黙の巨蟹$$. You'll disgrace your title as a Third Stage Reactor.」

295:t_103:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You've killed your emotions? Impressive, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

295:t_104:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You certainly made trouble for us in $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

295:t_104:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$沈黙の巨蟹$$... Your darkness is deep and cold...」

295:t_104:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Which is darker: the $$無限獄$$ I dwelled in, or your void...?!」

295:t_105:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Do you intend to fight us to avenge your family, whose fate was twisted?」

295:t_105:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I won't become a $$メガノイド$$ bound by ego...! So I won't fight for revenge!」

295:t_105:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! $$破嵐万丈$$ and $$ダイターン３$$ will face anyone who seeks to shroud the world in darkness!」

295:t_106:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(The fight with the $$メガノイド$$s is over... But $$クロノ$$ was behind it...)

295:t_106:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(...My revenge is over... From here on, I'll devote my life... to humanity's future.)

295:t_106:2.en:
$$万丈$$
(The future will come without becoming $$メガノイド$$s...! I'll prove it!)

295:t_107:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's why I fight...! To free you... and bring peace to the universe!」

295:t_108:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The four $$スフィア$$s within me...」

295:t_108:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Soon I'll understand... how to use this power...」

295:t_109:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
(The people of $$インサラウム$$ told me no one lives here in Mars's $$マリネリス峡谷$$...)

295:t_109:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Master... I don't know where you are now, but $$ノノ$$ believes you're doing well.)

295:t_109:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
($$ノノ$$ will do her best too...! I believe I'll become like $$ノノリリ$$ someday...!)
